candidate_contract.camera_center: translation of the official camera-to-world transform
candidate_contract.eligible_cameras: all Stage 1 retained cameras with finite rigid camera-to-world transforms

claim_boundary: Target-free camera-panel policy only. It does not establish visibility, provider competence, observation accuracy, calibration, physical improvement, or confirmation performance.

selection.center_normalization: subtract the mean eligible-camera center and normalize each radius to unit length
selection.objective_primary: maximize the minimum pairwise Euclidean chord distance among normalized camera-center directions
selection.objective_secondary: maximize the sum of all three pairwise chord distances
